properties.html: Being very confident of winning the 900 m racing competition, Dhaval started some distance behind the starting point. He finished the race in 28 seconds. 16 seconds after the start, he was exactly at the mid-point of the 900 m track. How far behind the starting point did Dhaval start from?

properties.html: Shiva started walking from point X to point Y and Vishal started walking from point Y to point X. Both start walking together at 7.00 am. After walking for 2 hours, they met each other and discuss something serious. The discussion was of two hours. Then, they continued their journey to reach Y and X respectively. However, after meeting their speeds reduced to half of their initial speeds. After one hour, Vishal turns around and walks at 2.5 times his present speed to meet Shiva. If the ratio of Shiva's and Vishal's initial speeds was 3:2, at what time would Vishal meet Shiva?

properties.html: Fred is chasing his friend Mohin. Mohin takes three jumps for every two jumps that Fred makes but each of Fred's jumps is twice as long as a jump of Mohin. Mohin had made 10 jumps when Fred started. The total number of Mohin's jumps when Fred caught Mohin?

properties.html: In a relay running race, 3 men representing the same team, who have to run equal distances, can complete the team race in 14 minutes with each of them running at the same speed. If one of them runs at 33 1/3% of his actual speed due to ill health, in how much time will they complete the race?

properties.html: Two men P and Q started walking towards each other simultaneously from two places L and M respectively, which are 72 km apart. They met after 9 hours. After their meeting, P reduced his speed by 2 kmph and Q increased his speed by 2 kmph. They arrived at M and L respectively at the same time. Find the speed of P.

properties.html: A and B both starts walking simultaneously from the point P towards point Q. The ratio of the speeds of A and B are in the ratio 13 : 7. After reaching Q, A starts walking back towards P and meets B. If PQ = 500 m. Find the distance of their meeting point from point P (in meters).

properties.html: Cities P and Q are 3600 km apart. Bus A starts from city P towards Q at 8 AM and bus B starts from city Q towards P at the same time. Bus A travels the first one-fourth of the distance at a speed of 30 kmph, the second one-fourth at 40 kmph, the third one-fourth at 50 kmph and the fourth one-fourth at a speed of 60 kmph. Bus B travels the first one- fourth of the total time taken at a speed of 30 kmph, the second one-fourth of the total time at 40 kmph, the third one-fourth of the total time at 50 kmph and remaining one- fourth of the total time at 60 kmph. Where will the two buses cross each other?
